report.incidentSummary: On 2026-10-21 at 10:55 IST (05:25 UTC), Payments operations reported that the 10:00 IST (04:30 UTC) redemption payout batch had not finished and metrics dashboards for payouts failed to load, leaving 2412 users waiting for their redemption proceeds. Investigation revealed that at 04:26:00 UTC (09:56 IST), automated schema migration 0142 initiated 'ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT \'\''. This DDL statement acquired an AccessExclusiveLock on the payout_instructions table. When job-scheduler triggered payout-batch-am at 04:30:00 UTC, payout-service queued 2412 redemptions but was blocked waiting for a RowExclusiveLock on payout_instructions. The migration held the lock for over two hours, preventing any of the 2412 payouts from being processed and causing concurrent metric/dashboard read queries on the table to block and time out.
report.rootCauseStatement: Redemption payouts were delayed because schema migration 0142 (CHG-48223) executed 'ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT \'\'' at 04:26:00 UTC (09:56 IST), acquiring an AccessExclusiveLock on the table to rewrite it. When the scheduled 10:00 IST payout batch (PB-1021-AM) started at 04:30:00 UTC, payout-service was blocked waiting for a RowExclusiveLock on payout_instructions, halting all 2412 payouts and blocking read queries from payout metrics dashboards.

hypotheses.cause: Schema migration 0142 executed ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT '', acquiring an AccessExclusiveLock on payout_instructions four minutes before the scheduled 10:00 IST batch, which blocked all RowExclusiveLock updates needed by batch PB-1021-AM and AccessShareLock read queries for dashboards.
hypotheses.rationale: Database logs explicitly identify process 48213 holding the lock and blocking payout worker processes starting at 04:31:56Z for over 136 minutes. Payout-service logs confirm 0 of 2412 payouts were sent due to waiting on payout_instructions lock.

hypotheses.cause: Partner bank payout APIs (bank-apis) degraded or rejected payout requests.
hypotheses.rationale: Bank-connector metrics show steady request rate and normal error rates (~0.7%). Payout-service explicitly logged that 0 of 2412 payouts were sent to banks because the batch never acquired the database lock to issue instructions.
No deployments occurred on payout-service since 2026-10-14 (version 2.6.2 deployed a week prior).

facts.statement: At 2026-10-21T04:26:00.000Z, deploy-bot started schema migration 0142 (CHG-48223) on database: 'ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref' with status in_progress.
At 2026-10-21T04:30:00.000Z, job-scheduler triggered scheduled job payout-batch-am (run_c582287b).
At 2026-10-21T04:30:06.000Z, payout-service started payout batch PB-1021-AM with 2412 redemptions queued.

Starting at 2026-10-21T04:31:56.146Z through at least 2026-10-21T06:41:45.684Z, database logged repeated warnings that worker processes were waiting for RowExclusiveLock on relation payout_instructions, blocked by process 48213 executing 'ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT \'\''.
payout-service logged 72 lock wait warnings and 4 errors for batch PB-1021-AM indicating lock wait exceeded 1800s, 3600s, 5400s, and 7200s, with 0 of 2412 payouts sent.
bank-connector request rate and bank_error_rate remained at normal baselines (~17-19 req/s, error rate ~0.7%) between 04:20:00Z and 05:30:00Z, showing partner bank APIs were not failing.
order-service request rate and database connection pool in use (~18 connections) were stable throughout the incident window, showing database connectivity was not globally exhausted.

inferences.statement: The ALTER TABLE statement with a NOT NULL DEFAULT clause rewrote the payout_instructions table, requiring an AccessExclusiveLock for the entire duration of the backfill/table rewrite.

Because AccessExclusiveLock conflicts with all other lock types (including RowExclusiveLock for DML and AccessShareLock for SELECT), all transactions modifying or reading payout_instructions were blocked.

assumptions.statement: Metrics dashboards for payouts failed to load because exporter/dashboard queries reading from payout_instructions were blocked behind the AccessExclusiveLock or timed out.

recommendedActions.action: Inspect database process 48213; if still running and not near completion, terminate/cancel the migration transaction to immediately release the AccessExclusiveLock on payout_instructions, allowing payout-batch-am to process pending redemptions.
recommendedActions.rationale: Process 48213 has held the table lock for over 136 minutes, blocking 2412 redemption payouts. Terminating or completing it releases the lock.
recommendedActions.verification: Check database logs to confirm process 48213 is no longer active, and verify payout-service logs show batch PB-1021-AM acquiring locks and successfully sending payouts.

recommendedActions.action: Reschedule and restructure schema migration 0142: add the column as nullable without a default value (ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text), then backfill values asynchronously in small batches.
recommendedActions.rationale: Adding a nullable column without a default in PostgreSQL is metadata-only and avoids a prolonged table rewrite and exclusive lock.

recommendedActions.action: Establish automated deployment safeguards preventing DDL migrations on critical tables during or immediately preceding scheduled batch job windows (10:00 IST and 14:00 IST for payouts). Set a strict lock_timeout on all migration sessions.
recommendedActions.rationale: Running DDL 4 minutes prior to a scheduled batch risks immediate lock contention, and unbounded lock wait times cause prolonged SEV2 incidents.
recommendedActions.verification: Verify CI/CD deploy pipeline enforces schedule restrictions and applies lock_timeout (e.g. 5s) on database migration connections.

# Investigation report: Redemption payouts delayed

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** completed · **Confidence:** 0.98 · **Written by:** baseline agent

## Summary
On 2026-10-21 at 10:55 IST (05:25 UTC), Payments operations reported that the 10:00 IST (04:30 UTC) redemption payout batch had not finished and metrics dashboards for payouts failed to load, leaving 2412 users waiting for their redemption proceeds. Investigation revealed that at 04:26:00 UTC (09:56 IST), automated schema migration 0142 initiated 'ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT \'\''. This DDL statement acquired an AccessExclusiveLock on the payout_instructions table. When job-scheduler triggered payout-batch-am at 04:30:00 UTC, payout-service queued 2412 redemptions but was blocked waiting for a RowExclusiveLock on payout_instructions. The migration held the lock for over two hours, preventing any of the 2412 payouts from being processed and causing concurrent metric/dashboard read queries on the table to block and time out.

**Root cause:** Redemption payouts were delayed because schema migration 0142 (CHG-48223) executed 'ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT \'\'' at 04:26:00 UTC (09:56 IST), acquiring an AccessExclusiveLock on the table to rewrite it. When the scheduled 10:00 IST payout batch (PB-1021-AM) started at 04:30:00 UTC, payout-service was blocked waiting for a RowExclusiveLock on payout_instructions, halting all 2412 payouts and blocking read queries from payout metrics dashboards.

## Hypotheses
1. **Schema migration 0142 executed ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT '', acquiring an AccessExclusiveLock on payout_instructions four minutes before the scheduled 10:00 IST batch, which blocked all RowExclusiveLock updates needed by batch PB-1021-AM and AccessShareLock read queries for dashboards.** — `database`, infrastructure_failure, confidence 0.98, supported
   - Supporting: [ev_1, ev_5, ev_6, ev_7, ev_12, ev_17, ev_19, ev_20, ev_24] · Contradicting: none
   - Database logs explicitly identify process 48213 holding the lock and blocking payout worker processes starting at 04:31:56Z for over 136 minutes. Payout-service logs confirm 0 of 2412 payouts were sent due to waiting on payout_instructions lock.
2. **Partner bank payout APIs (bank-apis) degraded or rejected payout requests.** — `bank-apis`, upstream_dependency_degradation, confidence 0.01, ruled_out
   - Supporting: none · Contradicting: [ev_9, ev_10, ev_17]
   - Bank-connector metrics show steady request rate and normal error rates (~0.7%). Payout-service explicitly logged that 0 of 2412 payouts were sent to banks because the batch never acquired the database lock to issue instructions.
3. **Recent payout-service application deployment regression.** — `payout-service`, deployment_regression, confidence 0.01, ruled_out
   - Supporting: none · Contradicting: [ev_24]
   - No deployments occurred on payout-service since 2026-10-14 (version 2.6.2 deployed a week prior).
